title: C sos_ratelimit: host test suite consuming sos_rate_limiting.json vectors
description: Smallest slice of l1qw.25 (decompose-first): sos_ratelimit.c (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/sos_ratelimit.c) is implemented and vector-backed per its spec (12-apps 18.4.3: 10-min cooldown, 3/hr, burst 2) but has ZERO tests and zero callers. Create host CTest lichen/tests/sos_ratelimit consuming test/vectors/sos_rate_limiting.json: first_sos_accepted, burst_second_accepted, third_before_cooldown_rejected (COOLDOWN_ACTIVE, remaining 300s), third_after_cooldown_accepted, fourth_in_hour_rejected (HOURLY_EXCEEDED), hourly_window_slides, different_nodes_independent, cooldown_resets_on_accept. Follow-up slices of .25 (separate beads): wire ratelimit+verify into SOS rx path, register /sos in coap_server.c.
close_reason: Host CTest lichen/tests/sos_ratelimit consumes test/vectors/sos_rate_limiting.json against lichen/subsys/lichen/link/sos_ratelimit.c (previously zero tests, zero callers): first-SOS allow, burst-2 allow, third-within-cooldown reject (COOLDOWN_ACTIVE, remaining 300 s), post-cooldown accept, fourth-in-hour reject (HOURLY_EXCEEDED with window-bounded remaining), hourly_window_slides faithful vector replay (inclusive cutoff retains sos_in_window=2), different-nodes independence, cooldown-reset semantics (accepted alert counts toward the hourly cap — the hourly cap dominates cooldown once three records are in-window, both spec limits 18.4.1), NULL defensive-allow contract. Coupling gate: all pinned vector names must remain in the JSON. Fixed the third_before_cooldown vector's internal arithmetic (current_uptime_ms 300000->301000 so elapsed matches its stated 300 s remaining) and its spec anchor (18.3 -> 18.4.1). Gates: ctest green under ASan/UBSan, gcc -Werror -Wconversion clean, cppcheck clean. Reviews: pass1 (kimi-k3) found 3 real defects — slides case not replaying the vector, JSON never parsed (silent-drift risk), vector arithmetic inconsistency — all fixed; pass2 found wrong spec anchor 18.3 -> 18.4.1 (fixed in JSON; C comment anchors kept at the standing 18.4.3 convention); pass3 timed out -> self-review fallback (state invariant ordering, boundary, NULL guards re-verified). Remaining slices of parent l1qw.25: rx verify+ratelimit wiring and /sos CoAP registration (sibling bead).
